ev.q: In 2019, the number of reported travel-associated dengue cases in the United States was 168% higher
The number of dengue cases per million air trips to destinations outside North America or Europe in 2019 (41.9 per million)
a smaller proportion of patients was hospitalized (33%)
was nearly twice that during other years during 2010–2021 (21.0 per million)
These rates varied by region of travel across the periods analyzed.
This report compares the number and characteristics of travel-associated dengue cases reported to national surveillance
U.S. jurisdictions reported more travel-associated dengue cases in 2019 than in any other year
